summary: Compare projections with peers only where the divergence check is on; settle first sync on claims

replay.detail: No replay. Only in-memory comparison state and the receive-path decision change.

schema.detail: No table, index or storage version change.

rules.detail: Peer projection comparison is the optional divergence diagnostic. Without ST3_DIVERGENCE_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS a daemon compares no projections on receive or in status, records no comparison, reports no divergence (doctor, client sync notices, DIVERGED lines and the terminal UI stay quiet) and names no comparison wait. With it set, behavior is unchanged. A first sync ends when both nodes hold the same envelopes and this node has admitted and projected them all, whether or not the peer sent projection digests.

compatibility.detail: No wire change. Exchanges still carry graph and projection digests, which older members need to end their own first sync.

manual.detail: An operator who wants divergence reports keeps or sets ST3_DIVERGENCE_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS on the daemon.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an earlier binary restores comparison on every exchange; nothing is persisted.
